device: Apple M4 Max, 40 GPU cores, 48 GiB unified memory
method: Isolated Metal kernels. All tensors retain their original precision and sizes. No device tensor allocation during dispatch. Synthetic values and balanced expert routing; repeated weights may remain cached. One warmup plus four timing rounds in alternating variant order. GEMM trials each contain four dispatches; attention trials contain one. Every candidate output byte is compared with production, including guard bytes. These timings are not full-model throughput. On-chip threadgroup memory varies, up to 32 KiB; process-level tensor storage does not grow.

independent_poison_validation.method: Repeated the complete kernel suite with output and guard storage reset to 0xFF before each reference and candidate check. This detects skipped stores that could otherwise retain the previous reference output. Initialization occurs before timing; the timing records above retain the first measurement run.
